name: Omarchy Agent Stats
author: andrewKnown
description: Per-agent rate-limit meters, prepaid balances (OpenRouter), Claude extra usage, Gemini API usage and today's token total in the bar, built on Omarchy's own Agents usage data. Click an agent to open it in a terminal.

barWidget.description: Two thin meters per subscription (session over weekly), prepaid balances such as OpenRouter's, Claude extra usage, and today's total tokens, with optional low-usage rings. Click an agent to launch it, right click for a menu (providers & keys, show/hide, update frequency, …), middle click to refresh.

schema.label: Update frequency
schema.description: Best effort. Off follows Omarchy's own schedule (15 minutes by default). Max is the shortest interval each source allows: Claude's limits and extra usage every 5 minutes (Anthropic refuses more often), other agents every minute, OpenRouter every 30 s, Gemini every minute. An interval applies to all of them. Agents are refreshed through Omarchy's own updater (omarchy agent usage-update).

schema.label: Agent badge
schema.description: Letters (CL, CX, GK) or each agent's logo from Omarchy's Agents plugin.

schema.label: Pulse while an agent is working
schema.description: Gently pulses an agent's badge while its CLI is busy. Checks local process CPU every 3 seconds.

schema.label: Low usage alert
schema.description: Draws a ring in the bar's urgent colour around an agent when any of its limits is nearly used up. Pulse makes the ring breathe.

schema.label: Alert when remaining is at or below (%)
Prepaid agents show
schema.description: For prepaid accounts (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Fireworks): the remaining balance, or what was spent today or this month.

schema.label: Low balance alert at ($, 0 = off)
schema.description: Rings a prepaid agent (using the Low usage alert style) once its balance is at or below this amount.

schema.label: Query OpenRouter directly
schema.description: Asks openrouter.ai once a minute for exact spend today, this week and this month (UTC) and the balance. With a management key the spend is the whole account's (every key summed), otherwise the one key's. Keys come from OPENROUTER_API_KEY / OPENROUTER_MANAGEMENT_KEY or ~/.config/omarchy/agents/openrouter.json. Off: numbers come from Omarchy's records and spend is counted locally.

schema.label: Check Claude extra usage
schema.description: Asks Anthropic's usage endpoint (the one Claude Code's /usage reads) every 5 minutes for this month's extra usage, using the sign-in Claude Code keeps in ~/.claude/.credentials.json. Shows the spend on hover, and in the bar while a plan limit is used up.

schema.label: Claude extra usage shows
schema.description: While on extra usage: the credit left this month as $ and % (Left), or what has been spent (Spent).

schema.label: Providers hidden from the bar
schema.description: Comma-separated agent ids to leave out of the bar, e.g. grok,kimi. Toggle them from the menu's Show in bar row.

schema.label: Google Cloud projects for Gemini API usage
schema.description: Comma-separated project ids whose Gemini API (AI Studio) usage to show: requests and tokens today, from Google Cloud Monitoring with your gcloud sign-in. Pick them in Settings & providers. Empty = off.
